overclaims: Typical subscriptions stayed at $20 and top plans at $200.
Scattered changes do not show that prices across the board are changing, and two months of stable prices do not disprove an open-ended forecast.
Changes in usage per price (like Anthropic's limit cut) could count under a looser reading.
Or, against it, those prices holding over a long period such as a year or more.
checks.note: The index compares September 20–October 19, not two months. Its subscription figures are medians; it also records replacement of OpenAI's $200 top tier with a $500 tier. Anthropic's limit cut lacks an included evidence item. The payload omits the early-resolution threshold of main-plan list-price changes at three specified providers and adds a year-or-more benchmark absent from the contract.
